jobDescription:
Platform Engineer (DevOps)

About the role
We are looking for a Platform Engineer to join our infrastructure team. You will own our Kubernetes platform, CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure, and help product teams ship faster and more safely.

What you will do
- Design, build and operate our Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS) using Terraform and Helm
- Own GitOps delivery with Argo CD and GitHub Actions; keep deployments fast and reversible
- Improve observability with Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry; define SLOs and alerting
- Drive incident response, run blameless postmortems and reduce MTTR
- Harden our cloud security posture: IAM least privilege, secrets management with HashiCorp Vault, SAST/DAST in pipelines
- Support PostgreSQL and Redis in production, including backups and disaster recovery
- Write tooling in Python or Go to automate repetitive operational work
- Mentor engineers on infrastructure as code and platform best practices

What we are looking for
- 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker and Helm
- Production experience with AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, VPC networking)
- Terraform at scale, module design and state management
- CI/CD with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD; GitOps with Argo CD
- Monitoring and logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or similar centralized logging
- Scripting in Python, Bash or Go
- Linux administration and networking fundamentals

Nice to have
- Azure or GCP experience
- Service mesh (Istio or Linkerd)
- Cost optimisation (FinOps) experience
- On-call experience and runbook writing

Why join us
Remote-first team, modern stack, and real ownership of the platform.
